section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) conducted in Brazil with 288 participants (52.8% men) who completed the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS), Intuitive Eating Scale-2 (IES-2), Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and demographic questionnaire. The study assessed psychometric properties of Brazilian Portuguese translations of the CEMS and IES-2, with results indicating adequate factorial validity, reliability, and invariance across sex, though specific demographic details (age, education, BMI values, and correlation coefficients) are not provided in the abstract.
